house_style: Warm painted children's science-book illustration, soft gouache and colored-pencil texture, rich lunar slate, cream, blue Earth and amber light. Clear shapes, detailed materials, gentle directional lighting, layered foreground, middle ground and background. No people, faces or body parts. No text, letters, numbers or logos.

assets.name: base
assets.prompt: Inside a cozy round moon base control room, a big round window showing grey lunar surface and blue Earth in black sky, consoles with blank screens, warm amber practical lamps, curved metal ribs and rivets. Leave the center open for job badges.

assets.name: greenhouse
assets.prompt: Inside a moon base greenhouse dome, rows of leafy green plants and tomatoes in trays under round grow lamps, grey lunar surface outside glass, warm soft light. Clear view of central planting trays, broad dome ribs, blank equipment.

assets.name: surface-solar
assets.prompt: Grey lunar surface with rows of blue solar panels in bright sunlight, long black shadows, small moon base dome in the distance, black sky with blue Earth. Cratered foreground, directional low sunlight, space for a game overlay.

assets.name: ice-crater
